method: All source code cells ran without edits. Supplied a display collector and seeded NumPy. Additional tests called the source functions directly.

checks.deutsch_jozsa: For each distinct source-generated truth table, checked the full 16 by 16 oracle permutation, original one-shot decision and statevector probabilities against squared Walsh coefficients.
checks.bernstein_vazirani: Checked the source one-shot decoder against every four-bit secret.
checks.native: Exported every listed circuit through OpenQASM 3 and qasm-import.py, then ran the adapter payload with quantum-worker --exact-circuit. Compared all outcome probabilities with squared Walsh coefficients or the secret at 50 digits with absolute tolerance 1e-12. The importer lowers pi/8 to a decimal.
